senses.gloss:
(ञि औ) ञिऔरुह r. 1st cl. (रोहति)
1 To grow from seed, to grow as a tree, &c.
2 To be produced or become manifest.
3 To be born.
With अधि prefixed,
To go up or over, to ascend.
With अधि and आङ्,
To ascend.
With अव,
To descend.
With आङ्.
1 To mount, to ride on.
2 To rise, to ascend.
With प्र,
To grow, to shoot forth as a branch or shoot taking fresh root.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Growing, springing up.
2 Mounted, ascended.
E.
रुह to grow, aff. क.

f. (-हा)
Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.)
E.
रुह to grow, affs. क and टाप्.

n. (-कं)
A hole, a vacuity, a cave, a chasm.
E.
रुह to go or mount, (insects, &c.,) and क्वुन् aff.

m. (-ह्वा)
A tree.
E.
रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिप्.
